summary.headline: Planetary Rulers and Enclosure
summary.text: Astrological rules rank the authoritative planet in each zodiac sign by house, trigon, and terms, then summarize the sign rulers. Sections 30 and 31 define conjunction or adhesion, separation, and enclosure, including malefic enclosure of the Moon or horoscope.
